description: Software accompanying the article 'Cognitive Diagrams: Reviewing Categorical Accounts of Linguistic Case' (working revision 2.5.0): executable case-role graphs, pregroup reductions, tensor contractions, synthetic similarity matrices, Bayesian belief filtering, quantile utilities, POVM measurement models, seeded synthetic studies, and a reproducibility archive. Code is distributed under Apache-2.0; the article text carries the separate manuscript deposit's cc-by-4.0 license.
title: Cognitive Diagrams: Reviewing Categorical Accounts of Linguistic Case
